subject: Request for Amendment to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the authoritative Shipping Instruction and found a few discrepancies that need to be corrected. Specifically, for the Consignee, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, whereas the draft Bill of Lading shows UAB NOVAKOPA. Additionally, for the Notify Party, the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC, while the draft Bill of Lading lists UAB NOVAKOPA. Please amend the draft Bill of Lading to match the Shipping Instruction in both instances. We look forward to receiving the updated document.

Shipping Operations
